lines.text: Private swap lets you trade one shielded asset for another, without it ever leaving the Vanish pool.
A normal swap shows the world your wallet, what you sold, and what you bought.
Choose what to sell and what to buy: Solana, dollars, or tokenized stocks like NVIDIA and Tesla.
Vanish fetches a live price through Jupiter, and shows exactly what you'll receive.
Your browser then builds three proofs: one for a refund, one for your new notes, and one that spends your input.
The trade runs inside the program, through an escrow that only this order controls. The pool's own funds never sign anything.
If the price moves past your limit, the swap cancels and your funds come back privately. And if the relayer ever disappears, anyone can cancel after the deadline.
On-chain, the pool simply traded. Your wallet appears nowhere.
Vanish private swap. Trade without a trail. vanish.website
